Australian phones, banks and the grid are normal, but our phone-network monitor is timing out, so we cannot watch carriers closely right now.

headline: A Houthi drone and missile attack hit Saudi Arabia's Jazan oil refinery, killing a worker and stopping part of it; SA fuel is normal for now.
summary: Saudi Arabia's energy ministry confirmed that a Houthi attack on Wednesday hit the Jazan refinery on the Red Sea coast, killing one worker and halting some operations. This is the first confirmed damage to a Saudi oil site in this round, and the Red Sea is Saudi Arabia's main way to get oil out while Hormuz is shut. Oil still fell about 2% today to about US$93 and SA pump prices are steady. We found no newly confirmed US strikes on Iran or attacks on US bases since yesterday. Hills fire danger is High tomorrow with strong winds; Australian phones, banks and power are normal, though our phone-network monitor is timing out.
